name: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Build a party and shape a branching fantasy adventure through tactical turn-based combat and meaningful choices.

name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
description: Experience the Modern Warfare 4 campaign set around conflict on the Korean Peninsula, competitive multiplayer and DMZ extraction gameplay. Standard Windows PC edition for Battle.net; no console entitlement is included.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Become a cyber-enhanced mercenary and explore the stories, districts, and dangers of Night City.

name: EA Sports FC 27
description: Experience football with updated teams, competitive matches, career mode, and online multiplayer.

name: Elden Ring
description: Explore the Lands Between in an open-world action RPG with challenging combat and deep character customization.

name: Forza Horizon 5
description: Race across Mexico in a shared open world featuring varied landscapes, seasonal events, and hundreds of cars.

name: God of War
description: Join Kratos and Atreus on a story-driven journey through Norse realms with visceral action combat.

name: Grand Theft Auto VI
description: Follow Jason and Lucia through Vice City and the state of Leonida. Standard PlayStation 5 listing; Xbox Series X|S is a separate edition, not included with this offer. Scheduled release: 19 November 2026. Demo purchases generate non-redeemable keys only.

name: Hades
description: Battle out of the Underworld in a fast-paced roguelike with evolving dialogue and powerful Olympian boons.

name: HELLDIVERS 2
description: Team up in a cooperative third-person shooter and complete dangerous missions using powerful equipment and coordinated tactics.

name: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Discover Hogwarts and its surrounding countryside in a magical open-world adventure set in the nineteenth century.

name: Hollow Knight
description: Explore a vast ruined insect kingdom in a hand-drawn action adventure filled with secrets and challenging bosses.

name: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
description: Become Miles Morales and protect New York City using powerful abilities, web-swinging, and fast-paced combat.

name: NBA 2K27
description: Experience professional basketball with competitive matches, team management, career progression, and multiplayer gameplay.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Follow Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang through a detailed open world at the end of the American frontier.

name: Stardew Valley
description: Restore a farm, grow crops, meet villagers, and explore mines at your own pace, alone or with friends.

name: The Last of Us Remastered
description: Follow Joel and Ellie through a dangerous post-apocalyptic world in an emotional survival adventure.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Play as monster hunter Geralt of Rivia in a story-rich open-world RPG filled with contracts and difficult choices.

name: Detroit: Become Human
description: Guide three androids through branching stories in a near-future Detroit. Your choices reshape their relationships and determine who survives. Windows PC edition for Epic Games.

name: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown
description: Explore Hong Kong Island, collect cars and compete in an online open-world racing championship. Standard Xbox Series X|S edition; requires an internet connection.

name: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut
description: Fight to protect Tsushima as Jin Sakai in an open-world samurai adventure. Director's Cut includes the Iki Island expansion. Windows PC edition for Steam; online features have separate account requirements.

name: Tekken 8
description: Master aggressive three-dimensional fighting, follow the Mishima family story and challenge rivals online. Standard PlayStation 5 edition; does not include season passes.

name: Resident Evil 4 (2023 Remake)
description: Join Leon S. Kennedy on a rescue mission through a hostile European village in the 2023 survival-horror remake. Standard Windows PC edition for Steam; Separate Ways is not included.

name: Gran Turismo 7
description: Collect and tune cars, complete driving challenges and race on detailed circuits. This listing is for the PlayStation 5 version, not a PC or Xbox key. Internet access is required for most modes.

name: It Takes Two
description: Work together as Cody and May in a varied two-player cooperative adventure. Full Windows PC game for EA App, not the free Friend's Pass. Requires two players.

name: Black Myth: Wukong
description: Become the Destined One in an action RPG inspired by Journey to the West, with demanding bosses and staff-based combat. Standard Windows PC edition for Epic Games.

name: Assassin's Creed Shadows
description: Explore feudal Japan as shinobi Naoe and samurai Yasuke, combining stealth and direct combat. Standard Xbox Series X|S edition; no PC entitlement is implied.

name: Halo Infinite (Campaign)
description: Return as Master Chief to confront the Banished on Zeta Halo. This demo offer represents the paid campaign for Xbox Series X|S, not the free multiplayer component.

name: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered
description: Swing through New York as Peter Parker in the remastered action adventure, including The City That Never Sleeps story content. Windows PC edition for Steam; distinct from Miles Morales.

name: Bloodborne
description: Explore the gothic city of Yharnam, battle terrifying creatures, and uncover its dark secrets in this action RPG.

name: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
description: Join Nathan Drake on a globe-spanning adventure filled with treasure hunting, cinematic action, and dangerous discoveries.

name: Horizon Zero Dawn
description: Play as Aloy in a vast open world inhabited by mysterious machines and uncover the secrets of a forgotten civilization.

name: Days Gone
description: Survive a dangerous post-apocalyptic world as Deacon St. John, exploring the wilderness on a motorcycle while fighting hostile creatures.

name: Astro Bot
description: Join Astro on a colorful platforming adventure across imaginative worlds, rescuing lost bots and discovering creative challenges.

name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
description: Swing through New York as Peter Parker and Miles Morales, facing powerful enemies in an action-packed superhero adventure.

name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
description: Travel between dimensions with Ratchet, Clank, and Rivet in a fast-paced adventure featuring futuristic weapons and colorful worlds.

name: Demon's Souls
description: Enter the dark kingdom of Boletaria in this challenging action RPG remake, battling dangerous enemies and powerful bosses.
